title: Filter and sort your deals
blurb: Use the list view to find stale quotes or big deals fast.

steps.title: Switch to list view
steps.body: Switch from the card board to the list view at the top of the page.

steps.title: See every pipeline
steps.body: In the pipeline dropdown choose **All Pipelines** to see every deal in one table.

steps.title: Filter
steps.body: Open the filters and add rules, like stage is Quote Sent and last updated more than 14 days ago. Those are your quotes to chase.

steps.title: Sort and pick columns
steps.body: Click a column header to sort, for example by value. Use the column settings to show or hide columns.
